title: Workspace member invitations — fictional planning example

requirements.statement: Only workspace administrators can invite members.

acceptance.statement: A member's invitation request returns forbidden and creates no invitation.
An administrator can invite a valid email address.

requirements.statement: Invitation acceptance rejects tokens older than 24 hours.

acceptance.statement: A token at exactly 24 hours is rejected.
A valid unused token younger than 24 hours can be accepted once.

decisions.summary: Use existing workspace authorization on both invitation creation and membership updates.
Store hashed single-use tokens with server-side expiration; enforce acceptance transactionally.

tasks.summary: Implement invitation creation and authorization checks.
Implement token acceptance with expiration and atomic consumption.

tests.summary: Planned authorization integration tests for administrator and member roles.
Planned time-boundary and concurrent token-reuse tests.

assumptions.statement: The example workspace has administrator and member roles.
